challenge.title: Hosting or Visiting: A Full Exchange
challenge.instructions: Write a short conversation where you either welcome a guest into your home from the door to the table, or visit someone else's home and take your leave at the end. Use at least one greeting at the door, one phrase about food or drink, and one closing or thanking phrase.
required_elements: a welcome phrase at the door (e.g. tikram 3eenak / tfaddal foot)
an offer of food or drink (e.g. shu bti7ebb tishrab?)
a closing thanks or goodbye (e.g. ya3tiikon l-3aafye / ma3 is-salaame)
